transcription.method: Manual visual transcription of both piano staves, incorporating the user's red pitch corrections and fingerings. Repeated figures carry the same fingering; alternative handwritten fingers are reduced to one choice.
transcription.rightHand: Printed notes retained in the LH-copy bars; octave-up notes already printed in bars 6–9 are not transposed again.
